nodes.description: Ownable owner address; assigned from _msgSender() in constructor and gates onlyOwner functions such as burn, createUniswapPair and addLiquidity.
Legacy Ownable storage slot for the previous owner; declared but never written after deployment.
Private token balance mapping (address => uint256) mutated in _tokenTransfer and read by balanceOf.
Nested allowance mapping (owner => spender => uint256) written by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Mapping marking accounts exempt from the transfer tax; writable by unprotected addToWhitelist/removeFromWhitelist.
Public blacklist mapping (address => bool); every transfer requires sender and recipient to be non-blacklisted.
Total token supply, initialised to TOTAL_SUPPLY * 10**DECIMALS in the constructor.
Current transfer tax percentage, initialised from INITIAL_TAX and reducible by the unprotected lowerTax function.
Payable address receiving collected ETH fees; set to the deployer (msg.sender) in the constructor and target of sendETHToFee.
Maximum buy amount enforced inside _transfer for pair buys; can be lifted by the unprotected removeBuyLimit.
Immutable-style reference to the Uniswap V2 router (0x7a250d...) used for swaps, liquidity and pair creation.
Address of the token/WETH Uniswap pair created in createUniswapPair; used to detect buys.
Flag guarding creation of the Uniswap pair so it can only be created once.
Reentrancy-ish guard set by the lockTheSwap modifier to prevent recursive swap handling.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token-to-ETH swaps inside _transfer; enabled after addLiquidity.
HoodDAO constructor: sets _taxWallet and _owner from msg.sender, sets _taxFee, _uniswap, mints total supply to itself and computes _maxTxAmount.
View returning the current owner address.
onlyOwner function irreversibly setting _owner to address(0).
Pure metadata getter returning the token name constant.
Pure metadata getter returning the token symbol constant.
Pure metadata getter returning token decimals.
View returning _tTotal.
View returning the stored balance of an account from _balance.
ERC20 transfer: forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to the internal _transfer routine.
View returning the allowance of a spender for an owner from _allowances.
ERC20 approve: calls _approve with msg.sender as owner and the supplied spender/amount.
ERC20 transferFrom: moves tokens via _transfer then decreases the spender allowance via _approve.
Private helper validating non-zero owner/spender and writing the _allowances mapping.
Core transfer logic: zero-address checks, buy-limit check, blacklist check, automatic swap-and-send ETH, then _tokenTransfer with tax.
onlyOwner function burning a percentage of the contract's own token balance by sending to address(1).
Unprotected function that marks an arbitrary address as excluded from fees.
Unprotected function clearing the fee-exemption flag for an arbitrary address.
Private lockTheSwap function approving and swapping contract tokens for ETH through the Uniswap router.
Unprotected function lowering _taxFee to any value below INITIAL_TAX.
Unprotected function that raises _maxTxAmount to the full total supply, removing the buy limit.
Private function transferring accumulated ETH to _taxWallet via a raw .transfer call.
Unprotected function that loops over an attacker-supplied array and blacklists every address in it.
Unprotected function clearing the blacklist flag for an arbitrary address.
onlyOwner function approving the router, creating the Uniswap pair and approving max tokens to the pair.
onlyOwner function adding ETH/token liquidity and enabling swaps and trading.
Accounting core: splits amount into tax and transfer amount, then mutates sender, recipient and contract _balance entries.
Empty receive function accepting plain ETH transfers into the contract.
Unprotected public function swapping the entire contract token balance for ETH.
Unprotected public function forwarding the contract's entire ETH balance to the tax wallet.
msg.sender: controls ownership on deployment, caller identity for transfers/approvals and the address used for owner checks.
block.timestamp: used as the swap and liquidity deadline, making execution dependent on miner-controllable time.
_taxWallet.transfer(amount): raw external ETH call executed inside sendETHToFee while token state may still be stale.
_uniswap.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens: external router call triggered from _transfer before balances are settled in _tokenTransfer.
_uniswap.addLiquidityETH: external payable call forwarding the whole contract ETH balance to the router.
IUniswapV2Factory(...).createPair: external factory call whose returned address becomes the trusted _pair.
recipient argument of transfer().
amount argument of transfer().
from argument of the internal _transfer().
to argument of the internal _transfer().
amount argument of the internal _transfer(), validated against _maxTxAmount.
contractTokenBalance local inside _transfer holding balanceOf(address(this)) passed to swapTokensForEth.
newTaxRate argument of lowerTax().
bots_ array argument of blockBots() whose elements are written into the bots blacklist.
burnAmount local in burn() computed as contract balance / 100 * percentage.
percentage argument of burn().
tTeam local in _tokenTransfer holding the tax portion of the transferred amount.
tTransferAmount local in _tokenTransfer holding amount minus tax.
sender argument of _tokenTransfer().
recipient argument of _tokenTransfer().
tAmount argument of _tokenTransfer().
taxRate argument of _tokenTransfer(), derived from _taxFee or zero for exempt accounts.
buyer argument of addToWhitelist().
buyer argument of removeFromWhitelist().
notbot argument of unblockBot().
tokenAmount argument of swapTokensForEth().
amount argument of sendETHToFee() transferred to the tax wallet.
account argument of balanceOf().
owner argument of allowance().
spender argument of approve().
sender argument of transferFrom().

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to the _owner state variable.
Constructor stores msg.sender as the payable _taxWallet fee receiver.
block.timestamp is supplied as the swap deadline, making the external swap timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is supplied as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
The _uniswap router reference is the target of the fee-on-transfer swap call.
_taxWallet is the destination of the raw ETH transfer.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth, an external swap, before _tokenTransfer updates balances.
swapTokensForEth performs an external router call before the lockTheSwap guard is released.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee to push ETH out while token accounting has not yet been applied.
sendETHToFee performs a raw external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
_transfer delegates balance accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer writes sender, recipient and contract entries of the _balance mapping.
The tax portion of _tokenTransfer is computed from the _taxFee state variable.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee for both parties to decide the applied tax rate.
_transfer enforces the bots blacklist for sender and recipient.
burn forwards the computed burn amount to _tokenTransfer.
addToWhitelist writes _isExcludedFromFee with no owner or permission check.
removeFromWhitelist writes _isExcludedFromFee with no owner or permission check.
blockBots writes arbitrary addresses into the bots blacklist without any access control.
unblockBot clears the bots blacklist flag without any access control.
lowerTax overwrites _taxFee without an owner check.
removeBuyLimit overwrites _maxTxAmount without an owner check, removing the buy cap.
swapForTax calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract balance.
collectTax calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.
createUniswapPair invokes the factory createPair external call.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH external call with the contract ETH balance.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom reduces the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
Constructor initialises _owner.
Constructor sets _tTotal from TOTAL_SUPPLY and DECIMALS.
Constructor sets _taxFee to INITIAL_TAX.
Constructor computes _maxTxAmount as _tTotal divided by 200.
Constructor assigns the Uniswap V2 router address to _uniswap.
renounceOwnership writes address(0) into _owner.
The router reference is used for the addLiquidityETH call.
The router factory() result is used to create the pair.
transfer uses msg.sender as the token sender.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender paying the allowance.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
addLiquidity sets _swapEnabled to true, enabling automatic tax swaps.
createUniswapPair stores the created pair address in _pair.
createUniswapPair guards on _canTrade to prevent double pair creation.
_transfer reads the _inSwap guard to avoid recursive swap handling.
The lockTheSwap modifier on swapTokensForEth toggles _inSwap.
The validated _transfer amount is forwarded to _tokenTransfer accounting.
contractTokenBalance is passed as the swap amount to swapTokensForEth.
Elements of the caller-supplied bots_ array are written into the blacklist mapping.
newTaxRate overwrites _taxFee without authorisation.
tokenAmount drives the swap amount inside swapTokensForEth.
The amount argument of sendETHToFee flows directly into the raw ETH transfer.
percentage controls the burnAmount computed inside burn.
taxRate is multiplied with tAmount to derive tTeam in _tokenTransfer.
tTeam is subtracted from the amount to derive tTransferAmount.
tAmount is the base value from which the tax is computed.
The _tokenTransfer recipient receives the credited balance entry.
The _tokenTransfer sender has its balance entry debited.
Caller-controlled buyer address is marked fee-exempt in addToWhitelist.
Caller-controlled buyer address is unmarked in removeFromWhitelist.
Caller-controlled notbot address is removed from the blacklist.
balanceOf reads the _balance mapping for the supplied account.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping for the supplied owner/spender pair.
approve ultimately writes the _allowances mapping for the supplied spender.
transferFrom forwards the supplied sender into _transfer.
The transfer amount flows through to the final accounting in _tokenTransfer.
The from argument selects the branch executed inside _transfer (pair buy vs other).

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter of transfer() belongs to the transfer function entry point.
The amount parameter of transfer() belongs to the transfer function entry point.
The from parameter is consumed by the internal _transfer routine.
The to parameter is consumed by the internal _transfer routine.
The _transfer amount parameter ultimately drives the balance accounting in _tokenTransfer.
contractTokenBalance is used directly as the amount of the swapTokensForEth call.
newTaxRate is the sole input written to _taxFee by lowerTax.
The bots_ array is iterated and written into the blacklist by blockBots.
burnAmount is computed and used only inside the burn function.
percentage is the sole input of the burn function.
tTeam is a temporary tax value inside _tokenTransfer.
tTransferAmount is a temporary credited value inside _tokenTransfer.
The sender parameter is debited inside _tokenTransfer.
The recipient parameter is credited inside _tokenTransfer.
tAmount is the accounting base of _tokenTransfer.
taxRate determines the split performed by _tokenTransfer.
buyer is the only input of addToWhitelist.
buyer is the only input of removeFromWhitelist.
notbot is the only input of unblockBot.
tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped inside swapTokensForEth.
amount is forwarded directly to the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
account is the lookup key of balanceOf.
owner is the lookup key of the allowance view.
spender is written into the allowance by approve.
sender is the debited account of transferFrom.
